chunks: Say: 'Determined is the day of the promise, which you can neither put back nor advance an hour.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Day of Promise cannot be delayed or hastened?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the absolute sovereignty of Allah over time, affirming that the Hour is a divine decree (hukm) immutable by human agency. It serves as a reminder of the inevitability of accountability, linking the cosmic certainty of resurrection to the spiritual readiness expected of the faithful.
